primary_claim: A single attention head (layer 5, head 5) in the Maia-3 chess transformer causally carries knight-fork move selection: mining hundreds of forks and ablating each head shows ablating head 5 costs 2.78 logits versus at most 0.14 for every other head in the same layer.

effect.metric: logit cost of ablating attention head on knight-fork move
effect.value: ablating head 5 (layer 5) costs 2.78 logits vs <=0.14 for every other head in the layer

stated_future_work: Extend chessformer_lens to other tokenization schemes beyond the completed Maia-3 interpreter
Much more analysis mining hundreds of forks planned for an upcoming paper
limitations_stated: This is a demo of the library's capabilities, so the public sample size is tiny (n=10 in the linked colab demo)
quote: ablating head 5 costs 2.78 logits whereas every other head in the layer costs ≤0.14
